summary: All 8 acceptance criteria exercised: 7 backend tests (all passed) + 9 browser checks (all passed, including one run through the public ingress URL). No bugs found.

checks.criterion: User uploads ONE audio file and a project is created
checks.name: upload-audio-creates-project
checks.evidence: Dropzone accepted /tmp/speech23.wav, app navigated to /projects/<uuid>, editor-page rendered with title 'speech23'; home card visible after navigating back.

checks.criterion: User uploads ONE audio file and a project is created (public ingress URL)
checks.name: upload-audio-creates-project-via-public-url
checks.evidence: Ran the same upload flow against https://doc-timeline-5.preview.emergentagent.com (APP_URL) — editor-page rendered correctly through the ingress path.

checks.criterion: Uploaded audio is stored in object storage and is streamable
checks.name: test_upload_creates_project_with_stored_audio / test_audio_stream_supports_full_and_range_requests
checks.evidence: POST /api/projects -> 201, audio.object_key startswith audio/<id>/, duration_seconds ~23s. GET /api/projects/{id}/audio -> 200 full body; Range bytes=0-999 -> 206 with content-range header, 1000 bytes returned.

checks.criterion: Audio plays inside the editor interface
checks.name: audio-playback-controls-timecode
checks.evidence: transport-play-button click advanced timecode-readout away from 00:00:00:00 within 5s; second click paused it (timecode stable across a 1.5s poll).

checks.name: transcript-segments-display-and-seek / test_transcription_completes_and_transcript_lists_segments
checks.evidence: Backend: polled GET /api/projects/{id} until transcription.status=='ready' (~7s), GET /api/projects/{id}/transcript returned >=1 segment with start/end/text. Browser: transcription-status-badge read 'transcript ready', transcript-list > transcript-segment-0 showed timestamp+text, same segment rendered in timeline-lane-transcript, click seeked audio.

checks.criterion: Timeline/editor UI loads with all lanes
checks.name: timeline-lanes-scrub-and-zoom
checks.evidence: timeline-ruler, timeline-lane-scenes, timeline-lane-transcript, timeline-lane-audio, timeline-waveform, timeline-playhead all visible. Clicking timeline-body moved timecode-readout. zoom-in/zoom-out/zoom-fit each ran with lanes remaining visible, no errors.

checks.criterion: Visual scenes lane is prepared but empty (stage 2)
checks.name: scenes-lane-empty-with-roadmap / test_scenes_endpoint_returns_empty_list_for_new_project
checks.evidence: Backend: GET /api/projects/{id}/scenes -> 200, []. Browser: scenes-lane-empty placeholder visible, scenes-panel showed exactly 4 scenes-roadmap-item cards.

checks.criterion: Render button exists but honestly reports it is disabled
checks.name: render-dialog-disabled-stage2 / test_create_render_returns_501_stage_two
checks.evidence: Backend: POST /api/projects/{id}/renders -> 501, detail mentions 'stage 2'. Browser: render-video-button opened render-dialog, render-confirm-button was disabled, no render-succeeded element ever present.

checks.criterion: Error and edge states are honest, and long processing does not break the UI
checks.name: unknown-project-shows-editor-error / transcription-processing-resolves-without-reload / test_unknown_project_returns_404 / test_non_audio_upload_returns_415
checks.evidence: Backend: GET /api/projects/unknown-id -> 404; POST /api/projects with text/plain file -> 415. Browser: /projects/unknown-id rendered editor-error with a visible back link (not blank); during transcription the amber processing badge showed while audio stayed playable (timecode kept advancing on play), then flipped to 'transcript ready' without any page reload.
